VANITY FAIR on Instagram: "First-time Oscar nominee @michaelbjordan has a lot to celebrate.

He earned his first Academy Award nomination for playing twins Smoke and Stack in Ryan Coogler’s ‘Sinners,’ which scored a history-making 16 Oscar nods and became a box office hit. “When did too much celebrating become a thing?” Jordan posits. “I’ve been so blessed and fortunate to have so many things going on—and successful things at that.”

After the Academy Nominees Luncheon, Jordan caught up with @beccamford to talk about the delicate demands of playing twins, how therapy has helped him as an actor, and why directing and starring in ‘The Thomas Crown Affair,’ now in post-production, has been even more demanding. Head to our link in our bio for the full interview."

Head to our link in our bio for the full interview.Every time I read or hear an interview of him, I fall a little bit more…. What a manThere’s only one thing you need to know about what happened at BAFTA and the use of the N-word: the BBC and BAFTA consciously and purposefully decided to keep it in the taped show. They could have edited it out, but they didn’t—and they did it on purpose, for the profit of Black pain and trauma. The white supremacist predator class that owns these media outlets thrives on profiting off Black suffering. That’s the only thing you need to know.This was an editorial decision, and they were probably giggling about it on editing day. So please, when you talk about it, understand that.The world itself has been built on Black pain—through talent, the arts, Africa’s resources, 400 years of labor, stolen music rights, and countless Black inventors erased from mainstream history. Black soldiers helped free Europe, yet their contributions are often ignored. Profiting from Black creativity, labor, and sacrifice has always been central to the systems of power. Clever marketing ensures that millions can watch the movie 🎦 at the expense of Black pain—Black pain for money. 400 years of Black pain for money and resources.Clever marketing even calling Michael B. Jordan the N-word to promote his cause, movie, and book deals.This John Davidson movie, I swear, is now number one on Netflix and Apple TV. Since yesterday, it has been watched by millions around the world.Now John Davidson is very famous; millions now know his name and his cause.Michael B. Jordan’s movie Sinner is Shadow by John Davidson. Millions are now talking about the John Davidson movie, I swear, at the expense of two fine Black actors. Black pain, white gain.Clever marketing strategy, in my opinion, yes. But why did the BBC edit out the “Free Palestine” speech? Come on, Black people.He’s a truly a gem. 💎 🌹Love everything about this man. 😍Amor eterno a Michael B Jordan 💖He deserves that Oscar this year for this performance. No other nominee comes close to what he has turned in on Sinners.@michaelbjordan CONTINUE ON YOUR PATH OF GREATNESS!! LOVE YOU ALWAYS BEST FRIEND!!LOVED THE MOVIE! He was brilliant in the role of “the twins”! However, reading this interview killed a few brain cells… Ufff!Sick and tired of the attacks on masculine men.That movie was too good and he played both characters so very well. I’m tryna watch it again right now!! 😍👏👏 well done performance and nod from the Academy! Get it MBJHe’s an amazing actor and he knows that fame and everything that comes with it is not real. But your work is realSo happy and proud of my best Friend Bakari. I cant wait to continually celebrate his success!! He deserves every flower and award!! Go Bakari . I love you always!! ❤️🙌🙌 👏 👏 👏 👑
